summary: Frontend-only end-to-end test of new /juego gamified explorer page for Xaluca Tours. Verified page load + all required data-testids, item toggle behaviour, percentage/stats updates, localStorage persistence (xaluca_juego_visited_v1), Reset (with confirm), level-up celebration banner crossing 10% threshold, badge change to 'Viajero Curioso', and trilingual routing (/juego, /en/game, /fr/jeu). Menu link 'menu-link-juego' present and navigates to /juego. All 26 critical testids present; all flows passed.

test_results.page_load: PASS - juego-page, juego-explore-ring, juego-explore-pct, 4 stat cards, juego-rank with 6 level steps (beginner/curious/atlas/desert/conqueror/legend), juego-map, 9 category blocks all rendered
test_results.initial_state: PASS - pct=0%, visited=0/73, regions=0/6, badge='Explorador Principiante', next='Viajero Curioso' (+10% para desbloquear)
test_results.item_toggle: PASS - Click juego-item-ci-marrakech => pct=1%, visited=1/73, aria-pressed=true. Second click => pct=0%, visited=0/73
test_results.mark_8_items_level_up: PASS - After marking 8 city items: pct=11%, visited=8/73, badge='Viajero Curioso', juego-celebrate banner visible
test_results.persistence: PASS - After full page reload: pct=11%, visited=8/73, badge='Viajero Curioso' all preserved. localStorage key 'xaluca_juego_visited_v1' contains JSON array of 8 ids
test_results.reset: PASS - Reset button triggers window.confirm; accepting clears state to pct=0%, visited=0/73
test_results.trilingual: PASS - /en/game loads juego-page with title 'How much of Morocco have you discovered?'; /fr/jeu loads juego-page with title 'Quelle part du Maroc avez-vous découverte ?'
test_results.menu_link: PASS - Side menu (after clicking header menu button) shows menu-link-juego with href=/juego that navigates correctly

critical_code_review_comments: JuegoPage.jsx is 476 lines — borderline of the 700 split threshold but acceptable for one self-contained feature. COPY block could be moved to a separate i18n file later for consistency with the rest of the app.
useVisited persists to localStorage on every state change; quota errors are silently swallowed (fine for this size).
Level-up celebration auto-dismisses after 4.5s; no e2e regression risk observed.

Map markers use react-leaflet CircleMarker click handlers — works but marker click in headless was not exercised (spec marked it optional); category-chip toggle path covers state sync logic since both call the same toggle().
seed_data_creation: None — localStorage cleared before test for clean baseline
context_for_next_testing_agent: All /juego flows verified working on preview URL. localStorage key is 'xaluca_juego_visited_v1'. Total places = 73. To trigger level-up to 'curious' mark 8 items (>=10%). Map marker click toggle was not exercised in headless (optional per request); category-chip path covers same toggle() logic.
